about.title: Luxury, Curated for You
about.heroDesc: Everything Street was built on a single conviction: that great skincare and great technology deserve the same standard of curation, sourcing, and trust.
about.missionDesc: We source directly from authorized distributors for every brand we carry. No grey-market supply chains. No ambiguity about provenance.
about.promiseDesc: Luxury is not just the product — it's the experience around it. Secure checkout, transparent tracking, 30-day returns, and a customer team that responds in hours, not days.
about.authenticityDesc: Every product is sourced from authorized partners. Counterfeits are not a risk we accept.
about.securityDesc: 256-bit SSL on every transaction. Your payment details and personal data are protected at every step.
about.globalDesc: Luxury without borders. We ship to over 50 countries — same quality, same care, wherever you are.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Everything Street.
faq.supportHours: Our support team is available Monday–Saturday, 9AM–6PM GET.

items.a: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days within the US. Express shipping (1–2 business days) is available at checkout. International orders typically take 7–14 business days.
Yes! All orders over $75 qualify for free standard shipping within the US. Orders below $75 have a flat $9.99 shipping fee.
Absolutely. Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number. You can also track your order in your account under 'My Orders'.
Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by destination. Duties and taxes may apply.
100% yes. Every product at Everything Street is sourced directly from authorized brand distributors. We have strict verification processes and zero-tolerance for counterfeits.

items.q: Where do you source your products?
items.a: We partner directly with official brand distributors and authorized retailers in the US, Europe, and Asia. Every brand on our platform has been vetted and approved.

items.q: What if I receive a damaged product?
items.a: Contact us within 7 days of delivery and we'll arrange a full replacement or refund immediately. We'll also cover return shipping costs for damaged items.
We offer 30-day hassle-free returns on all products. Items must be unused, in original packaging, with all tags attached. Beauty products must be unopened and sealed.

items.q: How long does a refund take?
items.a: Once we receive your returned item, refunds are processed within 3–5 business days and appear on your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

items.q: Are there any items that cannot be returned?
items.a: Opened beauty products (for hygiene reasons), personalized items, and digital downloads cannot be returned unless defective.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), and Cash on Delivery in select regions.
Yes. All payments are processed through Stripe, a PCI-DSS Level 1 certified payment processor. We never store your card information on our servers.
We currently do not offer gift cards, but new customers receive a welcome discount code for 15% off their first order.

items.q: How do I use a coupon code?
items.a: Enter your coupon code in the 'Coupon' field on the cart page or during checkout. Valid codes will automatically apply the discount to your order total.

items.q: Can I combine multiple coupon codes?
items.a: Only one coupon code can be applied per order. However, coupons can be combined with sale prices.

items.q: How do I change my password?
items.a: Go to Account → Profile and use the 'Change Password' option. You can also use 'Forgot Password' on the login page to reset via email.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.subtitle: Fast, reliable delivery to your door.
shipping.domesticContent:
Standard Shipping (3–5 business days): ₾15, FREE on orders over ₾200
Express Shipping (1–2 business days): ₾25

Orders placed before 14:00 GET are processed the same day.
shipping.internationalContent:
We ship to over 50 countries worldwide.

Canada & Mexico: 5–7 business days
Europe: 7–10 business days
Asia & Middle East: 10–14 business days
shipping.dutiesContent: International orders may be subject to import duties and taxes upon arrival. These charges are the responsibility of the recipient.
shipping.trackingContent: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. Track anytime from your account under 'My Orders'.
shipping.lostContent: Contact us within 7 days of the expected delivery date if your package is lost or arrives damaged. We will reship or issue a full refund.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.subtitle: 30-day hassle-free returns.
returns.overviewContent: We offer 30-day hassle-free returns on all products. Items must be unused and in original packaging.
returns.eligibleContent:
Items must be:
• Unused and in the same condition as received
• In original packaging with all tags attached
• For beauty products: unopened and sealed
returns.nonReturnableContent:
• Opened beauty products
• Personalized items
• Digital downloads
• Final Sale items
• Gift cards
returns.howToContent:
Email returns@everythingstreet.com with your order number and the item(s) you'd like to return. We'll reply within 24 hours with a prepaid return label.

Once we receive the item, your refund is processed within 3–5 business days.
returns.refundContent: Refunds are processed within 3–5 business days and appear on your payment method within 5–10 business days.
returns.damagedContent: Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos. We will arrange a free replacement or full refund.
